item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:53 PM 31 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Palawan(Quezon, SofronioEspanola, Narra, Aborlan, Dumaran, Taytay) and #Capiz(RoxasCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 16 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 16 FINAL #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 PM 30 August 2026

All RAINFALL WARNING over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 15 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 15 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 02:00 PM 30 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #OccidentalMindoro(Looc, Lubang, Paluan, AbraDeIlog, Mamburao and SantaCruz)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS POSSIBLE in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(Sablayan, Calintaan, Rizal, SanJose and Magsaysay) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.
